title: Goldreich–Levin stage step program
statement: For a dimension $n$, a threshold $\tau\in(0,1]$, an index $k<n$, a query state, and a finite family of active frequency sets, the stage step program uses the Goldreich–Levin stage estimates for that family to update the state at stage $k$, while charging the controller’s prescribed step work.
hypotheses_covered: finite family of active frequency sets
